# Tropis

> Tropis (τρόπις) — the keel. The foundation every product is built on: a
> pnpm monorepo with a NestJS backend (RPC first, served with Connect), a
> React console (helm), a Next.js public site (harbor), a transactional
> outbox and event bus, background jobs and Temporal workflows, realtime
> push and full observability. This file follows the llms.txt convention
> (https://llmstxt.org) so AI/answer engines can discover and cite the project.

## About

- Foundation ("keel") that products are built on, not a product itself.
- Two frontends split by audience: helm, the logged-in console (not indexed),
  and harbor, the server-rendered public site.

- Tech decisions (when to use each technology): /docs/tech-decisions.md
